jobs.title: Client Success Manager II
jobs.description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.


We’re looking for a Client Success Manager II to join our growing Client Success team.  
Do you love real estate? Do you enjoy talking to clients a lot? Are you hyper-organized, and project oriented? Do you enjoy helping people further their businesses by designing and executing bespoke digital marketing strategies? Do you want to play a pivotal role in the success of a client’s entire lifecycle? If so, we’d love to speak with you!
As a CSM II, you are a brand ambassador for Luxury Presence, an agile project manager and a strong account manager who owns a customer’s entire journey from sales to renewal. 
Your First Mission: To guide the build and design of award-winning websites for our highest tier clients. 
Your Second Mission: To foster a relationship with your client through understanding their business, brand, and marketing vision and turning that knowledge into action. 
Your Philosophy: To create a raving fan of every person that crosses your path.
Your skills will be put to the test as you actively implement websites for new marketing clients, while managing a book of previously launched clients through their annual marketing strategy.  Throughout the clients life cycle you will consistently exceed KPIs focused around speed, value and retention. This is a challenging and highly visible role in the company where you will be entrusted with our most important client relationships. Only those who love optimizing processes, enjoy serving clients, and have exceptional pride in their work need apply.  
You’re Good At:
Working with clients to lead strategy and offer guidance, set expectations, and provide reassurance during escalations
Project Management, as you’ll manage implementation and ongoing campaigns
Collaborating, working across departments to clearly communicate deadlines and expectations
Being curious, constantly looking to enhance your marketing tool kit, broaden expertise and improve processes
Managing a large portfolio of clients (up to $1.5M in ARR)
Expanding revenue
Staying even-keeled and lighthearted, with the ability to maintain a baseline when faced with stressful situations and demanding clients
Results-oriented work. Serving clients’ interests is always top of mind
Anticipating and understanding client vision, translating them into actionable next steps
Communicating with clients, particularly in explaining order of operations, technical complexities and setting expectations 
Identifying problems and proposing solutions
You Have:
2+ years experience managing a book of business e.g. Custom Success, Account Management, or related role
Working knowledge of SEO, Social, Content and/or Paid Media 
A track record of results-oriented success built on data and analytics
Prior success as a result of your innovation
Previous success working in fast-pace, high-volume environments and delivering every time
Previous experience with platforms like Squarespace, Shopify, WordPress etc.
Enthusiasm, competitive spirit, friendly and sunny disposition
An interest in the real estate industry (a passion is a plus)
You crush:
Navigating difficult situations
Adapting to client business needs and personality
Clear and persuasive with communication
Draw people in with your excitement and can-do attitude
Removing roadblocks for client and team members
Working efficiently and hitting deadlines   
Don’t take yourself too seriously
Job Requirements:
Located in Austin, TX or Scottsdale, AZ - Hybrid (In office 4 days a week for first 30 days, 3 days a week once you have successfully completed new hire training)
Working hours of 8:00am to 5:00pm CT

Join us in shaping the future of real estate
 
The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages.
 
We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition.
 
Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date.
 
More than 18,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner.
 
Every year since 2020, Luxury Presence has ranked on BuiltIn's Best Place to Work lists. HousingWire named our founder and CEO a 2024 Tech Trendsetter, we've received several Tech100 Awards, and we just scored an Inman Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform.
 
Luxury Presence is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

jobs.title: Director, Client Success - Austin, TX (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.


Why This Role Matters
Retention is how a subscription business compounds. Having crossed $100M in ARR, Luxury Presence's Client Success organization sits at a pivotal moment: a large and growing client base, a strong CSM team already in place, and a real opportunity to translate great client outcomes into durable, expanding revenue.
We're looking for a Director of Client Success to lead our CSM organization in Austin. You will lead a team of CSM managers and their CSMs, own the gross and net retention numbers, and build the operating model that lets us keep clients successful at scale. This is a builder's seat. You'll shape how the team is structured, how we score client health, how we run renewals and expansion, and how we coach a team to a consistently high bar.
You must be AI-forward. We expect our leaders to use AI and automation to extend team capacity, deepen client coverage, and make sharper decisions from data.
What You'll Own
Retention and Expansion
Own gross revenue retention and net revenue retention for the CSM book
Build and run the renewal and at-risk motions that protect recurring revenue
Partner with the team to grow upsell and expansion revenue across the base
Own a reliable retention and expansion forecast leadership can trust
Team Leadership
Lead, hire, and develop a team of CSM managers and their CSMs
Set clear targets and a coaching cadence so every rep knows the bar and how they're tracking
Manage performance directly, developing top performers and moving strugglers into better standing or out of the role
Build a high-ownership, low-ego culture that clients and teammates want to work with
Operating Model and Systems
Establish segmented coverage so the right clients get the right level of attention
Build a client health scoring model and the playbooks that act on it
Shape the QBR and business-review motion for high-value accounts
Use AI and automation to scale coverage and free the team to focus on the highest-impact work
Cross-Functional Leadership
Partner with Sales, Onboarding, Support, and Product to drive outcomes CS doesn't fully control
Represent the voice of the client inside the company and turn client signal into action
What We're Looking For
Experience
8+ years in Client Success or account management, with at least 3 years leading leaders (managing managers)
Proven track record owning and hitting gross and net retention or renewal and expansion targets
Experience scaling a CS team in a high-growth SaaS or subscription business
Built operating infrastructure before: health scoring, segmentation, playbooks, forecasting
Leadership and Mindset
Deeply execution-oriented with a strong sense of ownership over the number and the team
Hires and coaches well, and is willing to have hard performance conversations
Comfortable operating in complexity and ambiguity, and building where structure doesn't yet exist
Data-driven, and AI-forward in how you scale a team
Nice to Have
Experience in proptech, real estate technology, or serving SMB and entrepreneur clients
Compensation
Base salary: $160,000 - $190,000
Annual performance bonus
Equity
Comprehensive benefits
This is a hybrid role based in Austin, TX, with several days per week in our Austin office.

jobs.title: VP of Sales
jobs.description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.


Why This Role Matters
After crossing $100M in ARR, the next chapter is even bigger. We're looking for a seasoned sales leader to take the reins of our inside sales organization and lead it through the journey from $100M to $300M ARR.
This is not a caretaker role. You will own a team of roughly 120 people across SDRs, AEs, front-line managers, senior managers, and directors, and you will be responsible for the number, the talent, and the operating system that drives both. Our sales engine is good. Your job is to make it world-class. That means lifting productivity and efficiency across both inbound and outbound channels, deepening the leadership bench so the org scales without breaking, and partnering with our GTM Ops team to build a centralized, AI-powered selling model that gives every rep an edge.
You must be AI-forward. At Luxury Presence, AI is core to how we win, and we believe the future of selling is built centrally and executed by reps in the field. We are not asking your team to become builders. We are asking you to help identify where AI creates leverage and partner to build it for them.
If you are an operator and a builder, someone who has rolled up their sleeves in a startup and also taken a company to real scale, who leads from the front and knows how to motivate a floor, this is a rare opportunity to shape the next stage of one of proptech's fastest-growing companies.
What You’ll Own
Deliver the number. Own the inside sales revenue plan and consistently deliver against or above it, building the foundation for the $100M to $300M ARR journey over the next three to five years.
Drive world-class efficiency. Lift sales efficiency from good to great by increasing ARR per rep across inbound and outbound channels, with win rate and ramp time as supporting measures.
Build the leadership bench. Strengthen the director, senior manager, and front-line manager layers so every team has a capable leader and a clear line of succession as the org grows.
Deploy a centralized AI selling model. Partner with GTM Ops to identify where AI lifts productivity, build the tooling and workflows centrally, and roll them out so reps execute against a system built for them.
Install a rigorous operating cadence. Establish accurate forecasting, healthy pipeline coverage, and repeatable rep ramp playbooks that hold up as the organization scales.
Lead from the front. Set the bar, create urgency, and motivate the team to run through walls while holding everyone to a high standard of execution.
What You Bring
Experience
10+ years in sales leadership across multiple stages of company growth.
A track record that spans the full arc: the sleeves-rolled-up builder in an early-stage or startup environment, through to leading sales at a company operating at real scale.
Experience leading inside sales organizations of comparable size and complexity (front-line reps through multiple layers of management).
Demonstrated ability to grow a sales organization through a significant revenue inflection, ideally in high-growth SaaS or technology.
Leadership & Mindset
An operator and a builder. You build systems, processes, and teams from the ground up and you are not afraid to get into the details.
Relentless about results, with a closer's mentality and a strong sense of ownership over the number.
A motivator with genuine floor presence who earns respect and gets the best out of people.
AI-forward and future-oriented about how selling will evolve.
An egoless, cross-functional partner who builds alongside GTM Ops rather than in a silo.
Operational Foundation
Fluent in the metrics that drive an inside sales engine: ARR per rep, win rate, ramp time, forecasting accuracy, and pipeline health.
A builder of leaders who develops managers and creates durable succession depth.
Comfortable operating in complexity and ambiguity at a fast-growing company.
Drives from idea through execution: develops the strategy, establishes clear ownership, and keeps the team accountable for delivering.
What We’re Not Looking for
A playbook executor who just regurgitates/redeploys what they learned at a previous company. They need to have the strategic/tactical agility to pivot as needed and write a new playbook when it’s called for.
